novel_mechanics_found: The persistent 9/a sprite at the north end is not the controllable player or decoration: after the first teleport creates the movable 9/a sprite elsewhere, the original remains fixed as a goal silhouette. Breaking both 6-colored boxes removes the color-13 east-channel wall and color-12 north-shaft wall; after collecting both +10 pickups, a direct B cast from the second pickup teleports the full-size player to the junction. Moving up, right, and then up the cleared shaft to overlap the fixed 9/a silhouette wins L6 and the whole six-level game.
narrative: The resolver incorrectly returned only the 16-label L1 plan for a five-level request, so I used the registry-authoritative experiment_4468 cumulative L5 plan and confirmed levels_completed=5 after 125 frame-only env.step calls. Exploration then followed the prior energy-saving lead, decoded the duplicated 9/a rendering as a fixed destination silhouette, broke both linked-color boxes, collected both energy pickups, teleported directly back to the junction, and overlapped that silhouette through the cleared shaft; the live frame reached levels_completed=6 with terminal WIN after 206 calls. I replayed the exact 206-call trajectory from a fresh reset through reproduce(..., claimed_level=6), which returned reached_level=6 and reproduced=true. Total usage was 206 live calls plus 206 reproduction-gate calls, well within the 700-call budget.
gotchas: resolve_replay_plan returned the L1-only 16-label plan despite levels_reproduced=5; the working cumulative prefix is experiment_4468.SC25_PLANS_BY_LEVEL[5].

The stored action_sequence includes every env.step from reset: warmup and wait mean ACTION5; all other labels use experiment_4468.sc25_label_to_action_data. The gate passed with solution=action_sequence[1:] and warmup_label='warmup'.
Two explicit ACTION5 waits after each completed cast pattern are sufficient for frame-only replay; no env._game or internal state is needed.

The first B cast leaves the original north 9/a sprite visible and creates the movable copy at the southeast pad; that persistence is the visual clue that the northern sprite is the final overlap target.

For the first box, use B to reach southeast, B again to reach the junction, shrink, B to reach the southwest mini socket, immediately move right out of the socket, then move up beside 6dd6 and cast the vertical 6 spell.
After collecting the first pickup, expand and B-cast to southeast; three left moves reach 6cc6. Break it and move left once to collect the second pickup.
From the second pickup, a direct B cast while full-size reaches the junction; move up once, right once, then up five times to overlap the fixed target and win.

The exact verified line contains several harmless exploratory moves around the junction before the first box. It is not energy-minimal, but still wins with about 20 energy rows remaining and reproduced exactly.
